title: Junior Content Capture Analyst - Document Conversion
descriptionHtml:
CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients. 

 

Why us?

🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.

🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.

🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.

🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.

💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.

About CUBE

CUBE is a global regulatory technology company dedicated to helping financial institutions stay ahead of the ever-evolving compliance landscape. Our world-class Content Capture team sits at the heart of what we do — transforming complex regulatory documents into structured, high-quality digital content that powers our platform. We are a fast-growing, innovation-first organisation that embraces AI-driven technologies to continuously improve the speed, accuracy, and quality of our outputs.

The Role

We are looking for a Junior Content Capture Analyst to join our Content Capture Delivery team. In this role, you will support the conversion of PDF regulatory documents into accurate, well-structured HTML for publishing, contributing to BAU operations and quality improvement initiatives. Working alongside senior analysts and QA specialists, you will leverage AI-driven tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and help the team deliver consistently high-quality output on time.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their technical career who is eager to work with modern conversion technologies, build practical skills in HTML, CSS, C#, and .NET, and grow within a dynamic, collaborative team.

What You'll Do

Task Management & Communication

● Review and prioritise tasks based on project requirements and deadlines.

● Attend daily stand-up meetings to share progress, challenges, and next steps.

● Analyse and refine technical requirements received from team leaders.

● Maintain up-to-date task boards and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Internal Build Dashboards).

● Prepare daily work summaries and plan for upcoming meetings.

Conversion, Development & Implementation

● Convert PDF documents — including scanned and OCR-generated content — into clean, semantic, well-structured HTML, preserving content accuracy, formatting, and document structure.

● Analyse and convert complex document elements such as tables, images, lists, footnotes, and multi-column layouts into HTML.

● Identify and resolve OCR-related errors, formatting inconsistencies, and content extraction issues.

● Work on assigned coding tasks using HTML, CSS, .NET, C#, and JavaScript.

● Implement book-structuring solutions in line with project specifications.

● Ensure HTML output complies with project standards, accessibility guidelines, and publishing requirements.

● Debug and resolve conversion issues, software defects, and performance problems.

● Integrate and utilise AI-driven solutions to improve conversion efficiency wherever applicable.

Testing & Documentation

● Conduct testing to validate book structure alignment and HTML output accuracy against project requirements.

● Perform quality assurance checks to ensure converted HTML accurately reflects the source PDF.

● Document conversion changes, methodologies, development approaches, and testing outcomes for future reference.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

● Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from senior analysts.

● Work closely with the QA team to address bugs, validate conversion quality, and refine application performance.

● Collaborate with project teams to ensure accurate content structuring and adherence to publishing standards.

● Engage in knowledge-sharing sessions and training to enhance technical skills and stay aligned with industry best practices.

● Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills in handling complex PDF-to-HTML conversion tasks across multiple languages, including OCR and non-OCR content.

What You'll Bring

Essential Skills & Experience

● 6 months – 1 year of relevant experience in a technical content, publishing, or software role.

● Practical knowledge of HTML and CSS for structured document output.

● Foundational experience with C# and .NET.

● Familiarity with JavaScript.

● Understanding of PDF-to-HTML conversion processes and content structuring.

● Experience handling documents of varying complexity, including multilingual, OCR, and non-OCR content.

● Ability to manage assigned tasks and deliver within agreed timelines.

● Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality.

● Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

● Willingness to learn and adapt to AI-driven technologies and evolving processes.

Desirable / Nice to Have

● Experience with PDF and OCR conversion tools.

● Familiarity with AI-driven conversion or productivity tools.

● Working knowledge of Jira and/or Power BI.

● Basic experience with debugging and testing tools.

● Background in FinTech, BPO/BPM, IT Services, SaaS, or Digital Publishing environments.

Tech Stack

HTML / CSS

C#

.NET

JavaScript

PDF / OCR Tools

AI Conversion Tools

Jira

Power BI

What To Expect In Your First 6 Months?

You will be paired with a Senior Analyst buddy who will guide you through onboarding, helping you learn the existing PDF-to-HTML conversion process, tools, and quality standards. You will initially work on tasks matched to your experience level, gradually taking on greater complexity as your confidence grows. By the six-month mark, you will be expected to handle conversions independently, meet page-conversion targets, and actively use AI-driven tools to improve your productivity.

Why CUBE?

● Work with AI-driven technologies and modern PDF-to-HTML conversion solutions.

● Gain hands-on experience in C#, .NET, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and automation.

● Exposure to challenging technical problems across complex and multilingual content.

● Contribute to meaningful process improvements, automation, and productivity gains.

● Learn from and collaborate with experienced Senior Analysts, QA specialists, and project teams.

● Build specialist expertise in publishing, content structuring, and technical conversion.

● Be part of a team continuously improving its technology and processes to deliver faster, higher-quality outputs for customers.

Interested?

If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.​

CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
